mapper.select: SELECT id, step_number, step_code, name, is_common, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm FROM human_prompt_step WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE human_prompt_step SET step_number = #{stepNumber}, step_code = #{stepCode}, name = #{name}, is_common = #{isCommon}, final_rvis_pic = #{finalRvisPic}, final_rvis_dttm = #{finalRvisDttm} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS step_id, s.step_number, s.step_code, s.name AS step_name, s.is_common, a.id AS attr_id, a.name AS attr_name, a.is_multi_select, a.is_required, a.sort_order AS attr_sort_order, o.id AS opt_id, o.name AS opt_name, o.prompt_value, o.sort_order AS opt_sort_order FROM human_prompt_step s LEFT JOIN human_prompt_attr a ON a.step_id = s.id LEFT JOIN human_prompt_option o ON o.attr_id = a.id ORDER BY s.step_number ASC, a.sort_order ASC NULLS LAST, a.id ASC, o.sort_order ASC NULLS LAST, o.id ASC
